shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Calendar|DatePicker' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts; rg --files /home/sandbox -g AGENTS.md -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!proc'"' -g '"'!sys'"' -g '"'!dev'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && rg -n --max-count 2 -- 'g-color-text-brand-contrast:|g-color-line-brand:|g-color-line-focus:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
